sample_unit: chatbot responses (4 chatbots x 10 prompts) in January 2025

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of chatbot responses to pediatric chronic pain prompt
links.effect: With explicit scoring criteria, all chatbots attained readability below 7th grade; January 2025 responses showed substantial readability improvements versus January 2024.
links.quote: When provided with explicit scoring criteria, all systems achieved maximum usefulness scores (10/10) and attained a readability level below the 7th grade.

unlisted_practices: Providing explicit scoring criteria as context to chatbots to improve response usefulness and readability
Longitudinal re-benchmarking of chatbot responses over time

screen.practice: prompt guardrails (explicit scoring criteria as context)
screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM responses to a pediatric pain prompt and specifically tests the impact of adding explicit scoring/guidance criteria into the prompt versus standard prompting.

primary.practice: prompting with explicit scoring criteria and guardrails
